{
  "jobspec": "#!/bin/bash
#FLUX: --job-name=bead-select
#FLUX: --ntasks=1
#FLUX: --time=100:00:00
#FLUX: --queue=WitsLong

# The PBS directive 'mem=7GB' does not have a direct equivalent as a Flux batch directive and has been omitted.
# The performance implication is that the job may be scheduled on a node without enough memory, potentially causing it to fail.

# This script is intended to be run as a Flux job array, corresponding to the PBS '#PBS -t 0-1024' directive.
# A comparable Flux submission command would be 'flux submit --job-name=bead-select[0-1024] script.sh'.

hostname

cd  /spaces/scott/chip/pool_selection/

# The PBS array ID variable '$PBS_ARRAYID' has been replaced with the Flux task ID variable '$FLUX_TASK_ID'.
run=${FLUX_TASK_ID}
/usr/bin/time  python pool_select.py --input all.cpickle --label S${LABEL} --bad badscore60.lst --requests extra.lst,req_func_u.scores --factor 1.5 $run 10 18
"
}
